facts.fact: On the dawn of ch14, from the east terrace, Neela sees a single man come over the far ridge beyond the narrows and go down toward the dark scout camp while the patrol is bunched on the shelf; the scrub hides him and he does not reappear. She cannot act. No shot or horn follows.
Returning from the narrows in shape, Neela stops at the meeting stone in the pala grove and drags her cheek across the cup, a late scent-mark, before going to the cache.
